description: Repairs managed Codex subnode completion waiting and removes an unnecessary report digest requirement.
changelog:
**Bug fixes:**
- Adds channel barrier and channel wait --after-seq so coordinators can replay a fast subnode terminal event after dispatch.
- Removes the unnecessary brief_digest requirement from subnode reports while preserving brief and report identity checks.
- Validates explicit retry_of targets against an already-created sibling brief.
notes: No migration required. Existing projects can upgrade normally.
